sample_1.prompt: Studio Ghibli art style illustration. A curious young girl with short dark hair sits cross-legged under an enormous ancient tree, surrounded by glowing magical equations and luminous symbols floating in the air. She holds a glowing orb and studies it with a calm, focused expression. Soft watercolor textures, lush green forest background, warm golden sunlight filtering through leaves, whimsical and serene atmosphere.

sample_2.prompt: Studio Ghibli art style illustration. A young boy with tousled hair stands confidently on a grassy hilltop, one arm raised, looking back with a warm smile at a group of friends following closely behind him with admiring expressions. Wind sweeps through their hair and clothes. Vast open sky with soft fluffy white clouds, rolling green hills, warm golden afternoon light, painterly watercolor style.

sample_3.prompt: Studio Ghibli art style illustration. A small child sits at an old upright piano in a cozy sunlit cottage room, eyes gently closed in deep concentration. Musical notes drift up from the keys and transform into glowing butterflies floating toward the open window. Warm amber interior lighting, soft wooden textures, flower vase on the windowsill, magical and peaceful atmosphere, delicate watercolor style.
